basic_info.description: Bright and modern, this charming top floor studio apartment at 195 7th St, Unit 408, offers an open layout perfect for urban living. Located in the vibrant South of Market (SoMa) neighborhood, this residence features large picture windows that bathe the space in natural light and offer picturesque city views. The new sleek wide-plank hardwood-style flooring, neutral color palette, and recessed lighting create a contemporary and welcoming ambiance. The compact yet functional kitchen is equipped with granite countertops, crisp white cabinetry, and modern appliances, including a built-in microwave, electric stovetop, and compact refrigerator. A ceiling fan enhances comfort, while thoughtful built-in storage solutions, including a wardrobe and additional cabinetry, help maintain an organized and clutter-free living space. This studio is further enhanced by a built-in Murphy bed, which seamlessly folds away to maximize living space and functionality. The updated bathroom features a subway-tiled shower with a glass enclosure, polished chrome fixtures, and ample storage for added convenience. Situated steps away from San Francisco's best dining, shopping, and cultural attractions.  Shared roof deck with gorgeous views of the city.
